mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Imagine a place where privilege suddenly meets the harsh reality of prison life, where every day is a balancing act between identity, freedom, and dignity. That's exactly the world we step into as we follow Piper Kerman, whose story in Orange Is the New Black invites us to see beyond the stereotypes and discover what really happens when someone's life is thrown into the federal prison system. Together, we'll navigate the winding halls of confinement, where routines and small mercies shape each day, and where unexpected friendships offer moments of hope amid struggle. We’ll meet women from every walk of life—each bringing their own stories, burdens, and dreams—reminding us that humanity thrives even in the most unlikely places. Along the way, we’ll ask ourselves some big questions: What does justice truly mean? How do we adapt when everything familiar is stripped away? And, perhaps most importantly, what does it take to hold on to your sense of self? Through Piper Kerman’s eyes, we’ll see how humor, heartbreak, and solidarity can reveal the hidden dynamics of America’s prison system—and how the journey through confinement can spark not just endurance, but real transformation. So, let’s step inside together. There’s so much waiting for us to discover—about justice, resilience, and the heart of what makes us human.
